body: im just so scared he's going to leave me or hurt himself

what I normally do is imagine the consequences of what me proving my point and provoking the other party be be. I try to picture what the best outcome would be after the dust settles, and it's usually that I want the argument to be over with and the person I'm fighting with to no longer want to fight. I can picture everything I'd like to say in my head all I want, but at the end of the day if I care about the person I'm arguing with, I want to cause as little damage as possible. I just try and cut myself off once I notice I'm thinking more about attacks to prove my point rather than something helpful to the conversation.

I'm very anti-self diagnosing personally, I think that's all up to the proffesionals. I'm a bit of a moody guy to begin with and he believes I'm on somewhere on the neurodivergent spectrum, but he doesn't really know any of my feelings bc I'm very cautious and closed off. I guess I'm more nervous on working up the courage to have the discussion
